The DataTools4Heart Project · GitHub
sources.snippet: This organization hosts the source code and documentation for all components that power the DataTools4Heart (DT4H) platform — a federated, privacy-preserving cardiology data toolbox developed to enhance health data reusability. Our platform enables secure, decentralized analysis of cardiology data while strictly adhering to ethical, legal, and data protection standards.

sources.title: Home - DataTools4Heart
sources.snippet: Natural Language Processing DataTools4Heart will introduce a multilingual Natural Language Processing (NLP) suite to standardise the structuring of cardiology reports across European regions, including cardiology-specific entity recognition and machine translation. Such suite will include adaptation of 7 language models to the cardiology domain in English, Spanish, Italian, Romanian, Czech ...

sources.title: nlp4bia-bsc/DT4H_Multilingual_NER - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains code and documentation for multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) models developed within the DT4H (Data Tools for Heart) Europe Horizon project. The focus is multilingual clinical NER for disease, symptom, and procedure mention detection.
